component.name: Remote Desktop
component.summary: View and control this host's desktop from the browser

description.p: A fully web-based remote desktop for the host machine: Guacamole/guacd for GNOME VNC and GNOME RDP, tunneled through Cockpit's authenticated, TLS-encrypted WebSocket. Nothing to install on the client, no extra open ports.
Detects GNOME Remote Desktop VNC and GNOME Remote Desktop RDP, manages the remote desktop service, guides setup, sets GNOME VNC passwords safely, and shows health checks and service logs.
